title: SolClient preview screenshots
intro: A first look at SolClient v0.10, the add-on for the official Furcadia client: the control panel, SolClient Studio and the new Map Editor. It's still in development; release news and test builds happen in the Discord.

shots.title: Overview
shots.caption: Launch Furcadia as any of your characters, and see the connection, encryption, active modules and latest chat at a glance.

shots.title: Chat
shots.caption: A live, modern copy of your chat box: name colours, clickable links, and filters for speech, emotes, whispers and mentions.

shots.title: Whispers
shots.caption: One threaded conversation per person, saved per character.

shots.title: Dream: who's here
shots.caption: Who's in the dream with you and where they're standing, plus arrivals and departures, all from data the server already sends.

shots.title: DS Monitor
shots.caption: Live DragonSpeak variables and the most-fired DS lines, for testing your own dream.

shots.title: Modules
shots.caption: Every feature is a module you can switch on or off; changes apply right away.

shots.title: Friends
shots.caption: A friends-online tracker that checks one friend every 3 minutes, Furcadia's limit for add-ons.

shots.title: Backpack
shots.caption: A roleplay inventory per character. Others can whisper you @backpack to see it.

shots.title: Tools: macros, away, wardrobe
shots.caption: Multi-step macros, an away mode that answers each whisper once, and saved outfits.

shots.title: Alerts
shots.caption: Keyword sounds and taskbar flashes, a doorbell for whispers and summons, and a private ignore list.

shots.title: Logs
shots.caption: Search Furcadia's own chat logs for every character in one place.

shots.title: Console
shots.caption: What SolClient is doing, live, including the encrypted-connection check at login.

shots.title: Wire log
shots.caption: Every protocol line, labelled, for module writers. Login lines are never logged.

shots.title: Settings
shots.caption: Command prefix, plus the security settings: login protection and certificate pinning.

shots.title: About
shots.caption: The SolClient package: Control Panel, Studio, Map Editor, and a Patch Editor coming later.

shots.title: Studio: DragonSpeak editor
shots.caption: SolClient Studio: a DragonSpeak editor with a Blocks view, sections, templates, a DS reference and a problems checker.

shots.title: Map Editor: floors and picker
shots.caption: Your whole dream drawn with its real art, with a floor picker and paint tools. Edits go to a test copy.

shots.title: Map Editor: items
shots.caption: Painting items, with the dream's own patch art in the picker.

shots.title: Map Editor: select, copy, move
shots.caption: Select an area, then copy, cut, move or fill it.
